name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Senior .NET Developer | Azure & Microservices | RESTful API Design | CI/CD Pipelines | Cloud-Native Architectures
summary: Senior .NET Developer with 10+ years of experience designing and building microservices and cloud-native systems on Azure. Proven track record of developing scalable RESTful APIs, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and improving performance and reliability in distributed environments serving finance and retail.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices using .NET Framework/Core, supporting cloud-native inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs, reducing average response time by 25–35% through improved error handling, caching, and versioning strategies.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling frequent, reliable releases.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across microservices, increasing deployment success rate to >95%.
Enforced code quality practices (SonarQube, unit testing) across services, reducing production defects by 30%.
Partnered with cross-functional product and planning teams to deliver backend solutions improving forecast accuracy and reducing stock discrepancies.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit and mobile wallet operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing and service integrations, improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Participated in system design applying fault-tolerant patterns, improving resilience and reducing service downtime.
Centralized business rules, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Eliminated operational bottlenecks by automating decision logic, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Built dashboards enabling stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions and reducing reporting turnaround from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
